summary:
ASTRO CARE is a web-based prototype designed to display important health information for astronauts during space missions.

Astronauts may face health challenges in space due to the space environment and microgravity. Our project aims to make health information easier to view and understand through a simple dashboard.

The website displays sample heart rate, oxygen level and body temperature readings. It also includes health graphs, warning messages, an astronaut profile and space-related information.

We developed this project using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We also used Chat GPT and other digital platforms for ideas, guidance and development support.

Currently, the health readings are simulated sample data and are not collected from real astronauts or medical sensors.

Our Future Goal: We aim to improve ASTRO CARE by connecting real health sensors, adding secure data storage and developing more advanced monitoring features.

Our Mission: To explore how technology can help astronauts view and understand their health information during space missions.
details:
ASTRO CARE – Project Details

Team Name: Fearless Legends

Project Category: Health monitoring system

1. Project Summary

ASTRO CARE is a web-based prototype designed to display important health information for astronauts during space missions.

Astronauts may face health challenges because of microgravity and the space environment. Our project aims to make health information easier to view and understand through a simple dashboard.

Our website displays sample heart rate, oxygen level and body temperature readings. It also includes graphs, warning messages, an astronaut profile and space-related information.

We developed this project using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We also used ChatGPT and other digital platforms for ideas, coding guidance and development support.

Currently, the health readings are simulated sample data, not real measurements from astronauts or medical sensors.

Our future goal is to connect real health sensors, improve data storage and develop more advanced monitoring features.

2. Problem Statement

Astronauts face different health challenges during space missions. It is important to monitor and understand their health information. We want to create a simple system that displays important health information in one place.

3. Our Solution

ASTRO CARE is a simple website that helps users view sample astronaut health information through an organized dashboard.

4. Main Features

  1. Login page.
  2. Heart rate monitoring display.
  3. Oxygen level display.
  4. Body temperature display.
  5. Health graphs.
  6. Warning messages.
  7. Astronaut profile.
  8. Space and satellite information.

5. Technologies Used

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Chart.js
  • Chat GPT
  • Visual Studio Code
  • Other digital platforms used by our team.

6. Future Improvements

  • Connect real health sensors.
  • Add secure login facilities.
  • Improve data storage.
  • Develop advanced health alerts.
  • Improve the dashboard.

7. Team Details

Team Name: Fearless Legends

Project Name: ASTRO CARE

Our Mission: To explore how technology can help astronauts view and understand their health information during space missions.

Our Motto: Innovation for a Healthier Space Future!

8. Short Conclusion

ASTRO CARE is our first step towards exploring astronaut health monitoring technology. We hope to improve our prototype with real sensor connections and advanced features in the future.

Thank you – Team Fearless Legends!
